setting: a cozy kid bedroom at night, the same room as in the attached room picture if one is attached: soft warm peach walls, wooden floor, a low wooden bed with a rounded headboard along the back wall on the left, seen from its long side, with a white pillow at the headboard on the left and a smooth lavender blanket, raised on short legs with a dark gap under its front side; a small warm glowing lamp on a little wooden shelf on the back wall between the bed's headboard and the window; a window in the middle of the back wall showing a dark blue night sky with a crescent moon; a round cream rug on the floor in front of the bed; a rounded light-wood door on the right wall. Things look the same in every picture: Little Sprout is a small round terracotta-orange clay pot, a little wider than it is tall, with a rolled rim and dark brown soil at the top; on the front of the pot a simple cute face: two dot eyes, rosy cheeks and a small mouth; out of the soil grows one thin green stem with two round fresh-green leaves, the stem about as tall as the pot; the watering can is a small rounded sunny-yellow watering can with a long thin spout and a handle on top; the balloon is one round bright-red balloon with a small knot at the bottom and a thin curly white string hanging straight down from the knot, the string clearly visible and about twice as long as the balloon is tall. Few things, soft warm lamp light, gentle shadows. The bottom-right corner of the picture is plain wooden floor with nothing important in it

Cut by tool/sprite_sheet.py, placed per scene by docs/stories/keep_promise/stage.json (tool/stage.py). Only cover and sticker are normal pictures; icons are composed from sprites. New Gemini images: props_promise, hero_f, cover, sticker (4)

pictures.cover: Night, crescent moon in the window. {hero} stands on the round cream rug a little left of the middle of the picture, turned to the right, holding one hand up at shoulder height in a loose fist with only the little finger sticking up (a pinky promise), with a big earnest smile. Lulu floats in the air to the right of {hero}, as high as the head of {hero}, smiling, one paw raised; {hero} and Lulu do not touch. Below Lulu, on the floor right of the middle of the picture and well away from the bottom-right corner, stands Little Sprout: a small round terracotta-orange clay pot, a little wider than it is tall, with a rolled rim and dark brown soil at the top; on the front of the pot a simple cute face: two dot eyes, rosy cheeks and a small mouth; out of the soil grows one thin green stem with two round fresh-green leaves, the stem about as tall as the pot; the pot about one and a half times as wide as the girl's head; its face smiles, both leaves are lifted up like little arms and one tiny yellow five-petal flower is open at the top of the stem. Above {hero} and Lulu floats one round bright-red balloon with a small knot at the bottom and a thin curly white string hanging straight down from the knot, the string clearly visible and about twice as long as the balloon is tall; the string's end hangs free in the air and nobody holds it. The floor is clean and tidy. If a room picture or a props sheet is attached, the room, Little Sprout's pot and the balloon look exactly like in them
pictures.sticker: a round terracotta-orange clay pot, a little wider than it is tall, with a rolled rim and dark brown soil at the top; on the front of the pot a simple cute face: two dot eyes, rosy cheeks and a small mouth; out of the soil grows one thin green stem with two round fresh-green leaves, the stem about as tall as the pot; the face on the pot has its eyes closed in two happy curves, rosy cheeks and a big smile; both leaves are lifted up like little arms and one tiny yellow five-petal flower is open at the top of the stem; a small round bright-red balloon on a thin curly white string is tied to the pot's rim and floats right beside the flower, touching it, so the pot, the plant and the balloon make one sticker shape; no face on the balloon

props_promise.note: Every thing is seen from the same angle: from the front, slightly from above. The four plant pots are the very same pot at the same size and angle, with the same face in the same place; only the stem, the leaves, the face's expression and the flower change. The leaves are fresh green in every pot: never brown, dry or dead. Only the pots have a face: no face on the leaves, the flower, the watering can or the balloon. Sizes compared with the pot: the stem with its leaves is about as tall as the pot; the watering can is about as tall as the pot; the balloon is about as wide as the pot.

figures.sprout_thirsty: a small round terracotta-orange clay pot, a little wider than it is tall, with a rolled rim and dark brown soil at the top; on the front of the pot a simple cute face: two dot eyes, rosy cheeks and a small mouth; out of the soil grows one thin green stem with two round fresh-green leaves, the stem about as tall as the pot; the two leaves hang down a little, the face looks up with open eyes and a small worried-hopeful round 'o' mouth
figures.sprout_droopy: the very same pot; the stem bends over to the LEFT so both leaves hang down over the rim, still fresh green; the leaves hang beside the face, not over it, so the whole face stays visible; the face has its eyes closed and a small sad mouth, no tears
figures.sprout_happy: the very same pot; the stem stands straight up and both leaves are lifted up like two little arms; the face has open eyes and a big smile
figures.sprout_flower: the very same pot, stem straight and both leaves lifted up like in the happy pot, plus one tiny yellow five-petal flower open at the very top of the stem between the leaves; the face has its eyes closed in two happy curves and a big smile
figures.watering_can: a small rounded sunny-yellow watering can with a long thin spout and a handle on top, standing upright, the spout pointing to the RIGHT, empty, no water
figures.balloon: one round bright-red balloon with a small knot at the bottom and a curly white string hanging straight down from the knot, the string a little thicker than a thread and softly shaded so it stands out from the background, clearly visible and unbroken, about twice as long as the balloon is tall
